Apex Cloud and AI Corp evaluates standard new-hire offers up to 1.00 Compa-Ratio and 1.20x Equity Guideline within the Offers Desk. Current employees who have a projected 2026-to-2027 cashflow drop smaller than 10% with peer positioning above the 50th percentile are placed in Tier 0 to hold and take no proactive budget action.

For current employees, Tier 1 retention grants are sized at 50% to 75% of the annual equity refresh guideline over 24 months to restore 2027 intended cashflow to at least 90% of 2026 levels for those facing a projected cashflow drop between 15% and 22% or dropping below the 25th percentile. Meanwhile, new-hire reviews cover base bands, sign-on cash, equity at offer, and leveling at offer within Section 2.1 thresholds without costing proactive budget.

An off-cycle adjustment lifts a cliff-facing employee's base salary to at most a 0.95 compa-ratio while never lowering pay, whereas the compensation governance playbook states no rule for new hires regarding offer band reviews.
